items.statement: The model cannot capture large-scale features such as the longitudinal fissure, sylvian fissure, and specific gyri and sulci.
items.quote: The shape of the mammalian brain has a number of prominent large-scale features: the longitudinal fissure, the sylvian fissure, and many specific gyri and sulci with important functional correlates that we cannot capture with our minimal model.

items.statement: The mechanical model uses simplified geometries and material properties; real tissues may have stress-dependent growth and stress relaxation.
items.quote: Real brain tissues are known to change their growth rates in response to stress (20), and other mechanisms lead to relaxation of elastic stresses over time.

items.statement: The scaling law is empirical and does not specify the actual cortical shape beyond a constraint binding three morphometric parameters.
items.quote: this universality, presumed to be arising from universal physical principles and evolutionarily conserved biomechanics, says little about what that cortical shape actually is, beyond a constraint binding three morphometric parameters

review_rules: 一条陈述只标一个主要条件
product_present：被试自己的、必需的输入文件；文档写明可选的、软件自带的资源、内存数据结构都不算
attr_in：对单个文件属性取值的要求（物种、空间等）
attr_equal：多个文件之间必须一致的属性（被试、半球、网格、空间、体素大小）
software：必需的可执行程序或工具箱
provenance：要求某个处理步骤已经完成
advisory：目视检查、操作建议、结果解释注意事项、命令行用法、版本说明、方法自身的处理描述
陈述超出引文内容的，按建议性处理并标注
